description: Real-network smoke test for the Tavily-backed web_search tool. Requires HELIXIS_WEB__TAVILY_API_KEY to be set; otherwise this case skips (so CI without secrets stays green). With a valid key, asserts the tool returns ≥1 source with a URL, an unredacted query, and zero warnings.
